info.title: Crehler Payment Bundle - Payment Sub-Methods
info.description: Store API endpoints for retrieving payment sub-methods (e.g. bank list for online transfers, e-wallet options).

get.summary: Get sub-methods for a payment method
get.description: Returns available sub-methods (e.g. banks, e-wallets) for the given payment method ID. Sub-methods represent concrete payment options within a payment method type. Results can be filtered by payment value to exclude options outside their amount limits.

parameters.name: paymentId
parameters.description: UUID of the payment method to get sub-methods for.

parameters.name: paymentValue
parameters.description: Payment amount in minor units (e.g. cents/grosze). Used to filter sub-methods by their min/max amount limits. Defaults to 10000 (100.00).

200.description: List of available sub-methods for the given payment method

get.summary: Get sub-methods for current payment method
get.description: Returns available sub-methods for the payment method currently set in the sales channel context. Equivalent to calling the {paymentId} variant with the context's active payment method.

parameters.name: paymentValue
parameters.description: Payment amount in minor units (e.g. cents/grosze). Used to filter sub-methods by their min/max amount limits. Defaults to 10000 (100.00).

200.description: List of available sub-methods for the current payment method

PaymentSubMethodStruct.description: A single payment sub-method (e.g. a specific bank or e-wallet).

providerId.description: Provider-specific identifier for this sub-method. Used when saving the customer's selection via the customer sub-method endpoint.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the sub-method.

shopwareId.description: UUID of the parent Shopware payment method this sub-method belongs to.

mediaUrl.description: URL to the sub-method's icon or logo image.

minAmount.description: Minimum transaction amount in minor units for this sub-method. Null means no minimum.

maxAmount.description: Maximum transaction amount in minor units for this sub-method. Null means no maximum.
